name.value: Double Deckker Breakfast and Burger Bus

description.value: A roadside burger bus parked on the North Island Highway in Black Creek, serving homemade burgers, specialty hot dogs, poutine, chicken strips, soups, and hot beverages. The converted bus format makes it a distinctive stop along the Island's main touring corridor between Campbell River and points north. Online pickup ordering is available through its Square storefront.
